question.text: Under Ch 11.10 Code of Conduct, AIFs should disclose the name of all their Key Management Personnel (KMP) and the investment manager:

answer.text: In the Private Placement Memorandum, and any change in KMP shall be intimated to investors and SEBI
Only to SEBI, not to investors
On the public website within 24 hours of appointment

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.313 (Ch 11.10 Code of Conduct), AIFs should disclose the name of all their KMP and the investment manager in the Private Placement Memorandum. Any change in KMP shall be intimated to investors and SEBI, creating both an onboarding disclosure and an ongoing change-disclosure duty. The Trap: The other options understate the disclosure obligation — "only upon investor request", "only to SEBI", and the 24-hour public-website requirement are not what the source specifies. Note: Both initial PPM disclosure and ongoing intimation to investors and SEBI are required when KMPs change.
